evidence.title: What was actually asked for, 2026-07-25 to 2026-09-06
items: 'our AI OS, this front matter, this markdown capability … fuse them into generating something crazy'
'our compiler directly trigger into the rapid web building platforms like framer … the entire live application updates automatically'
'change a database schema in one section … the frontend component in another section breaks … the error is piped into your local Claude code'

options.label: Separate product, named and parked
gains: Keeps the 90-day plan buildable; the idea gets an owner
costs: Two products from one consulting income

options.label: One product, compiler in v2
gains: One brand, one codebase; the engine is a compiler front end
costs: v2 unbounded until Framer and healing are specified
options.system: The engine gains a token pass and render target.
options.money: Raises the v2 build cost materially.

options.label: Fold only the token pass into v1
options.what: YAML tokens compile to CSS variables; no Framer, no healing.
gains: Smallest slice that makes the vision visible
costs: Still needs a render surface to be worth anything
options.system: One new pass over frontmatter values.

Nothing is decidable until headline and form factor are. A named owner stops the resurfacing.
